title: N.C.R.B., (M.H.A.) CRIME IN INDIA-1997 1.17.3 The number of Police Districts in the country increased from 592 in 1996 to 632 in this year. The number of Districts, attaining the five figure mark in registering IPC cognizable crimes, increased to 13 with the addition of Bhopal city (11,344), Hyderabad city (11,060) and Pune Commissionerate (10,455) while those in the range of 5,000 - 10,000 declined to 73 from 91 in 1996. Thus, majority (nearly 86%) of the police districts have been observed to record less than 5,000 IPC cases per year.
